protocol.objective: Deduplicate unchanged bytecode-function checks inside canonical program preparation while preserving D049, public standalone validation, decoder and VM admission, every resource bound and all32 corpus inputs.

Keep all verifier algorithms and budgets unchanged.
protocol.full_gate: All32 paired 3+11 ON and OFF. Correct stdout, unchanged114 inputs and 64MiB. Candidate median sum must not increase in either mode. Any per-case median >2% or P90 >5% has exactly one predeclared same-case confirmation; a threshold repeated on the same metric rejects the candidate. Preserve failed/noisy observations. No repeat-until-pass.
protocol.validation: Focused allocation-index and finite verifier/codec budget tests; canonical function bytes in complete program equal public standalone encoding/lowering. Full ON/OFF suites, focused ASan/UBSan and Rosetta plus all32 workloads in each, mandatory architecture/memory/doc gates. No Linux LSan or Tier1 completion claim.

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import re
import subprocess
import time

root = Path.cwd()
base = root / 'build/bytecode-program-preparation'
smart = json.loads((base / 'SMART.json').read_text())
frozen = json.loads((base / 'frozen-inputs.json').read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert 'All validation completed; timing may now start.' in (base / 'validation.log').read_text()
identity=json.loads((base / 'identity/report.json').read_text())
assert identity['status'] == 'passed'
assert identity['builds']['after']['original_compiler_sha256'] == sha(base / 'mmay')
for suffix,count in [('full-on',96),('off',86),('asan',12),('x86',12)]:
    assert re.search(r'100% tests passed(?:, 0 tests failed)? out of '+str(count)+r'\b', (base / (suffix+'-tests.log')).read_text())
for suffix in ['asan','x86']:
    replay=json.loads((base / (suffix+'-all32-correctness.json')).read_text())
    assert replay['status'] == 'passed' and len(replay['workloads']) == 32
for p, h in frozen.items(): assert sha(root / p) == h, p
for label,p in smart['baseline'].items(): assert sha(root / p) == smart['baseline_sha256'][label]
result = {'status':'running','started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'protocol':smart,'frozen_inputs':frozen,'commands':[],'modes':{},
    'host_isolation':'local-unverified; sampled process/power/thermal state retained; no proof of an idle or dedicated host.'}

def store(): (base / 'measurement.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
def snapshot():
    snap={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    for key, command in [('processes',['ps','-axo','pid,ppid,%cpu,comm']),('power',['pmset','-g','batt']),('thermal',['pmset','-g','therm'])]:
        done=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
        snap[key]={'exit':done.returncode,'stdout':done.stdout,'stderr':done.stderr}
    return snap

def paired(mode, suffix, names=None):
    target=base/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.json')
    assert not target.exists(), 'Do not overwrite an existing measurement series'
    before=root/smart['baseline'][mode]
    after=root/('build/bytecode-program-preparation'+('-off' if mode=='off' else ''))/'mmay'
    command=['caffeinate','-i','python3','tools/performance/compare-vm-preparation.py','--benchmarks','../algorithm-benchmarks','--reference',
        'docs/implementation/evidence/cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json','--before',str(before),'--after',str(after),'--output',str(target)]
    for name in names or []:command+=['--workload',name]
    event={'mode':mode,'series':suffix,'command':command,'before_sha256':sha(before),'after_sha256':sha(after),'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    result['commands'].append(event);store()
    with target.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as log, target.with_suffix('.monitor.jsonl').open('w') as monitor:
        process=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        while process.poll() is None:
            monitor.write(json.dumps(snapshot())+'\n');monitor.flush();time.sleep(5)
        event['exit_code']=process.returncode
    event['finished_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();store()
    assert process.returncode==0, event
    data=json.loads(target.read_text());assert data['status']=='passed'
    return data

def metric_ratio(data, name, metric):
    if metric == 'p90_ms':
        # Existing 11-sample gate: nearest-rank P90 is sorted sample 10.
        assert len(data['raw_ms'][name]['before']) == len(data['raw_ms'][name]['after']) == 11
        return sorted(data['raw_ms'][name]['after'])[9] / sorted(data['raw_ms'][name]['before'])[9]
    row = data['summary'][name]
    return row['after'][metric] / row['before'][metric]

for mode in ['on','off']:
    print('Starting full',mode,'3+11 paired matrix',flush=True)
    data=paired(mode,'full')
    metrics={'median_ms':1.02,'p90_ms':1.05}
    flagged={n:[k for k,bound in metrics.items() if metric_ratio(data,n,k)>bound]
        for n,row in data['summary'].items()}
    flagged={n:v for n,v in flagged.items() if v}
    summary={'compiler_sha256':result['commands'][-1]['after_sha256'],
        'sum_before_ms':sum(row['before']['median_ms'] for row in data['summary'].values()),
        'sum_after_ms':sum(row['after']['median_ms'] for row in data['summary'].values()),
        'geomean_speedup':statistics.geometric_mean(row['before']['median_ms']/row['after']['median_ms'] for row in data['summary'].values()),
        'flagged':flagged,'confirmed':{}}
    result['modes'][mode]=summary;store()
    if flagged:
        print('One prescribed',mode,'confirmation:',', '.join(flagged),flush=True)
        confirmation=paired(mode,'confirmation',list(flagged))
        summary['confirmed']={n:[k for k in keys if metric_ratio(confirmation,n,k)>metrics[k]] for n,keys in flagged.items()}
        summary['confirmed']={n:v for n,v in summary['confirmed'].items() if v}
    summary['accepted']=not summary['confirmed'] and summary['sum_after_ms']<=summary['sum_before_ms']
    store();print(mode,summary,flush=True)
for p,h in frozen.items():assert sha(root/p)==h,p
result['status']='accepted-local' if all(s['accepted'] for s in result['modes'].values()) else 'rejected'
result['finished_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();store();print(result['status'],flush=True)

import hashlib

from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
base = Path('build/bytecode-program-preparation')
frozen = json.loads((base / 'frozen-inputs.json').read_text())
def verify():
    for path, digest in frozen.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, path
verify()
early = json.loads((base / 'early-paired.json').read_text())
assert early['status'] == 'passed'
import statistics
assert statistics.geometric_mean(x['before']['median_ms'] / x['after']['median_ms']
    for x in early['summary'].values()) >= 1 / .93

commands = []
def run(command, suffix, env=None):
    verify()
    print('Starting', suffix, flush=True)
    commands.append({'suffix': suffix, 'command': command, 'environment_overrides': env or {}})
    (base / 'validation-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands, indent=2) + '\n')
    with (base / (suffix + '.log')).open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run((['env'] + [k + '=' + v for k, v in env.items()] if env else []) + command,
                       stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    print('Passed', suffix, flush=True)

def tests(build, suffix, count, pattern=None, env=None):
    command = ['ctest', '--test-dir', build, '--no-tests=error', '--output-on-failure', '-j2']
    if pattern: command += ['-R', pattern]
    run(command, suffix + '-tests', env)
    assert re.search(r'100% tests passed(?:, 0 tests failed)? out of ' + str(count) + r'\b',
                     (base / (suffix + '-tests.log')).read_text())

def configure(build, suffix, options):
    run(['cmake', '-S', '.', '-B', build] + options, suffix + '-configure')
    run(['cmake', '--build', build, '-j4'], suffix + '-build')

def correctness(build, suffix, env=None):
    run(['python3', 'tools/performance/sljit-prototype/check.py', '--mmay', build + '/mmay',
         '--benchmarks', '../algorithm-benchmarks', '--reference',
         'docs/implementation/evidence/cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json',
         '--output', str(base / (suffix + '-all32-correctness.json'))], suffix + '-correctness', env)


commands = json.loads((base / 'validation-commands.json').read_text())
correctness('build/bytecode-program-preparation-x86', 'x86')
for suffix, tool in [('architecture','architecture'), ('memory','c-memory-policy'),
                     ('roadmap','roadmap'), ('doclinks','doc-links'),
                     ('specterms','spec-terms'), ('generated','generated')]:
    run(['./tools/check-' + tool], suffix)
verify()
print('All validation completed; timing may now start.', flush=True)

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

base = Path('build/bytecode-program-preparation')

record = base / 'fiveway-host-monitor.jsonl'

        output.write(json.dumps({'utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'power': subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'batt'], text=True),
